phase: Rosetta Research Workbench Phase I Slice 2B
purpose: Read pinned Google Drive and ACEB semantic authorities and emit WORKBENCH-CANONICAL-READ-v0.1 without creating a second scientific authority.

credential_policy.required_capability: read-only Google Workspace access to the declared personal-Drive authorities

authority_policy.google_docs: exact document ID, title, and revisionId must match the producer source manifest
authority_policy.aceb: exact spreadsheet ID, title, and observed modifiedTime must match the producer source manifest
authority_policy.effect_of_drift: No bundle is emitted until the source manifest and compatibility tests are reviewed.

projection_rules: Question, hypotheses, datasets, comparison-gate states, and claim-propagation rules are projected from ACEB rows.
Species activation and run records are projected from their named pinned Drive documents.
RUN-004 registered run disposition and claim-propagation disposition remain separate fields.
RUN-005/RUN-006 remain EMPIRICAL_EXECUTION_HELD with null disposition until their owning empirical authorities say otherwise.
Dataset semantic_authority is always NONE in the Workbench projection.
live_verification_boundary: CI verifies producer behavior against synthetic Workspace responses only. Live authenticated Drive/ACEB execution is a separate operational gate.
